title: RESKit MERRA-2 test fixtures, Aachen
description: MERRA-2 surface fields over a 3 x 4 cell box around Aachen, 71 hours of January 2015, one file per variable. `merged/` holds the same data with the eleven variables merged into one file.
ethos:derivation:
Collections M2T1NXRAD and M2T1NXSLV v5.12.4, pulled through the GES DISC subsetter in 2017 (`MERRA2_400.tavg1_2d_rad_Nx.*.SUB.nc4`), merged, split by variable in 2018, then `cdo -seltimestep,1/71 -sellonlatbox,5.2,7.2,49.7,51.7` in 2019.
merged/merra-like.nc4 is held in a subdirectory for the same scanning reason as the `era5-csp` single-cell file: a differently shaped file beside the per-variable ones would be picked up by the same directory glob.

sources.title: MERRA-2 tavg1_2d_rad_Nx and tavg1_2d_slv_Nx, v5.12.4 (NASA GMAO / GES DISC)
